title: Project Setup & Core Types
prerequisite: typed-function and workerpool TypeScript conversions complete

tasks.description: Initialize monorepo with npm workspaces - create root package.json with workspace configuration for core, matrix, functions, expression, parallel packages
Configure TypeScript, Vitest, ESLint - strict TypeScript config with ESM modules, Vitest for testing, ESLint for linting
Link typed-function-ts package - create symlink to local typed-function TypeScript port in packages/ folder
Link workerpool-ts package - create symlink to local workerpool TypeScript port in packages/ folder
Create core package structure - set up @danielsimonjr/mathts-core package with src/, tests/, package.json, tsconfig.json
Implement base interfaces - MathTSValue, Scalar, IMatrix, IComplex, MatrixBackend interfaces defining core type contracts
Implement number type wrapper - create number type with typed-function integration for runtime dispatch
Write core type tests - comprehensive tests for interfaces, type checking, and basic operations

successCriteria: Monorepo builds successfully with npm run build
typed-function package accessible via workspace:* protocol
workerpool package accessible via workspace:* protocol
Core type interfaces compile with strict TypeScript
Basic type tests pass with Vitest
notes: Sprint 1 establishes the foundational monorepo structure and core type system. The typed-function and workerpool packages are linked as local TypeScript forks for integrated development.
